subject: Discovery recap: signer routing & procurement readiness (Elara Health)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: signer routing & procurement readiness (Elara Health)

Thanks again for your time today, Samantha — quick recap and a few asks so we can make the next meeting with procurement as productive as possible.

Key takeaways from our demo:
- Elara is evaluating Redwood for conversational triage and summarization across two pilot clinics (approx. 6–8k visits / mo).
- Primary concern: data residency and billing cadence.
- Preference: centralized procurement (PO) vs purchasing card TBD — you mentioned procurement typically prefers PO for multi-year commitments.

Open items / asks:
1) Can you confirm who the budget owner is (name + title + email)?
2) Do you intend to buy through a cloud marketplace (AWS/GCP) or direct via PO? If marketplace, which one(s)?
3) Any preliminary signatory requirements (e.g., VP Finance vs CFO)?
4) Would Procurement/Legal like a draft PO or a sample SOW in advance?

Next steps I propose:
- I will put together a short "procurement checklist" and a signer-lane sketch for your approvals team and share before our follow-up.
- Suggested 30-min sync with your procurement + finance next week — please propose a few times.

Attached: procurement_questions_Elara.pdf (short checklist we use to speed approvals).

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@elarahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Todd Jenkins <todd.jenkins@elarahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: signer routing & procurement readiness (Elara Health)

Ben — thanks for the clear recap and for the checklist. Quick answers below and a matrix attached.

- Budget owner: Todd Jenkins, VP Finance (todd.jenkins@elarahealth.com). Todd signs off on pilot spend before procurement routes the order.
- Purchasing path: For pilots under $50k we can sometimes use card, but anything multi-year or >$50k goes through PO. This will likely be a PO for the pilot given expected scale.
- Marketplace interest: We prefer direct procurement for first pilots but are open to moving to AWS Marketplace later for ease of renewals.
- Signatory lane: typical flow is Budget Owner (VP Finance) -> Procurement -> Legal -> Signatory (CFO). Procurement owns PO issuance.

I've attached "Elara_approver_matrix.xlsx" with the names we discussed and an internal procurement contact (Renee Park).

Let's target Tue/Thu next week for the procurement call — Todd and Renee can join.

Thanks,
Samantha

--
Samantha Lee
Director, Clinical Operations
Elara Health
samantha.lee@elarahealth.com
Attachment: Elara_approver_matrix.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: signer routing & procurement readiness (Elara Health)

Looping in a couple quick suggestions before we do procurement sync:
- Prepare a one-page PO-friendly summary (key line items + billing cadence) — keeps procurement happy.
- We should surface sandbox/PII controls for the pilot (data residency note) in that doc.
- Send a clean PO template and our standard net-30 billing terms; legal can iterate after their review.

I can draft the PO summary if you want — I have a template that aligns with marketplace vs direct paths.

Marissa
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Proposed MAP + next steps (procurement sync)

Thanks, Samantha — appreciate the matrix. I pulled together a short Mutual Action Plan and a proposed signer-lane graphic for procurement so everyone is aligned. Links and attachments below.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- By Tue 1/19: Ben to share PO summary + Redwood PO terms (attached).
- By Wed 1/20: Elara procurement to confirm PO template and procurement contact (Renee).
- By Thu 1/21: 30-min procurement + finance sync to review PO fields and approval SLAs.
- Post-sync: Redwood legal to open DocuSign with our PO terms; Elara legal to redline.

Attachments: redwood_po_terms_v1.pdf
Drive MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/drive-map-elara-2027
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ElaraHealth

Please reply with the best time Tue/Thu and confirm attendees (Todd, Renee, any others). If procurement prefers to handle via marketplace we can map to that process as well.

Best — Ben

Confirmed: procurement will want a PO for this pilot; Renee will share Elara's PO template in the meeting and Todd will confirm approval thresholds.

We reviewed the MAP link and redwood_po_terms_v1.pdf — looks good as a starting point. Renee will upload the PO template to the meeting invite and Todd will bring any cost-threshold questions.

See you Tuesday.

Samantha
